result_summary: The simple continuous genealogy risk map reduced aggressive transients but failed to robustly dominate fixed beta=0.5 on recurring validation. A separate online residual-frequency layer substantially improved gradual box coverage but retained large recurring transients. The strongest next direction is a certificate-gated defensive backbone: keep fixed beta=0.5 always available and admit an aggressive correction only after an anytime-valid proxy certificate, with the proxy-to-true-variance bridge evaluated separately.
blocker: No theorem-clean single-run generation-wise variance estimator specifically for the independent-stratified multi-generation particle filter was established. No observable proxy-to-true-allocation-variance certificate has yet been derived, so any future gate is proxy-safe only until that bridge is closed.
